1.

Praise, worship, adoration, and glory We bring home to Thee, O Jesus Christ, Our God and Redeemer! Obedient to the Father unto death, Thou becamest our Deliverer in distress, From eternal death our Saviour. The grave did not hold Thee, Though it was sealed; To Thy Father Thou didst return, And now Thou art For us in God’s presence there.

2.

High at the Majesty’s side We see Thee, Lord Christ, and await With joy Thy appearing. The Father hath crowned Thee with glory, With the oil of gladness God hath anointed Thee, Thou Firstfruits of the resurrection. Yet heaven still holds Thee, who wast abased; But in glory and majesty Thou shalt come And reign over all the world.
